about_the_game:
Swarm Sweeper is a rogue-like game where players take on the role of a trooper tasked with defending a base from relentless waves of strange creatures. Players must rely on skill, speed, and smart strategy to survive and eliminate every threat.

Fight the swarm, upgrade your weapons and abilities to become even deadlier.

  • Unlock special abilities and enhancing your stats.

  • 6 type of guns those you can use for wiping out the swarm.

  • Fight through 5 dangerous levels in an abandoned space station.

  • Fight against 5 brutal bosses.

Arm yourself and choose a weapon that matches your playstyle and adapts to every challenge you face.

  • Handgun: Basic gun with infinite ammo.

  • Shotgun: Short range gun that can push enemies away.

  • Rifle: Auto-aim medium range gun with high fire rate.

  • Heavy machine gun: No auto-aim medium gun with low fire rate but hit hard.

  • Sniper: Auto-aim long range weapon that can kill everything in straight line.

  • Flamethrower: Kill everything with fire around yourself.

Fight your way through each level until you reach the escape pod.
